product.name: Configurator Builder
product.description: Option and variant configurator for anything configurable — clothing sizes and colours, phone storage and colour, furniture, service packages or a SaaS plan builder: option groups, rules@1 dependencies and exclusions, a pure closest-match resolver with in-stock preference, price deltas with rounding, URL sync and an accessible drop-in widget. Standalone, or fed by catalog events; all data in the merchant's own database.

elements.name: Configurator schema
elements.description: Configurators: option groups (single, multi, range, text) in order, required options and defaults, hidden options, swatches and images, dependencies and exclusions written in rules@1, optional combinations (variant matrix with SKU, stock and price) — defined directly or linked to a catalog item fed by item.* and inventory.changed@1 events.

elements.name: Resolver
elements.description: Pure, deterministic closest-match resolution of a partial selection to a valid combination: the option just picked wins, then the shopper's other picks, then stock (prefer / require / ignore), defaults and a tie-break (schema order, price, popularity); fill or keep partial selections; fallbacks (closest, defaults, reject) and a clear problem when no valid combination exists. Runs in the browser (headless) and behind the evaluate API.

elements.name: Price deltas
elements.description: Price of a configuration in integer minor units: base or combination price, per-option deltas, per-unit prices of range options, rules@1 delta rules (amount or percent) per combination or quantity, rounding (nearest / up / down to an increment, optional price ending) and a breakdown.

elements.name: URL sync
elements.description: Selection ↔ URL query parameters: parameter names and prefix, multi-value separator, defaults omitted or kept, history replace or push, and canonical rules (base URL or the canonical selection) so shared links and bookmarks land on the same configuration.

elements.name: Configurator widget
elements.description: The embeddable selector: pills, dropdowns or swatches per group, ARIA radio groups with arrow-key navigation and visible focus, price and summary, out-of-stock and "we changed your selection" notices, a notify-me hook for alerts and URL sync — drop-in, headless or API.

elements.name: Evaluate API
elements.description: Server-side evaluation: resolve a partial selection, price it and build its URL in one call, for browsers (pk_) and servers (sk_); rate-limited per website and metered per evaluation.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: Configurators with rules, the closest-match resolver, URL sync, the widget and the evaluate API (10 000 evaluations per hour included); price deltas as an add-on.

plans.name: Pro
plans.description: Everything, including price deltas, larger schemas and 100 000 evaluations per hour included.
